learning_review_events_rating_check.name: learning_review_events_rating_check
learning_review_events_rating_check.value: rating IS NULL OR rating IN ('again', 'hard', 'good', 'easy')

learning_review_events_consistency_check.name: learning_review_events_consistency_check
learning_review_events_consistency_check.value: (event_kind = 'rating' AND rating IS NOT NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NULL) OR (event_kind = 'undo' AND rating IS NULL AND undoes_event_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_kind = 'reset' AND rating IS NULL AND reset_epoch IS NOT NULL)

learning_targets_item_check.name: learning_targets_item_check
learning_targets_item_check.value: (target_kind = 'whole' AND item_block_id IS NULL) OR (target_kind = 'item' AND item_block_id IS NOT NULL)

topics_editor_mode_check.name: topics_editor_mode_check
topics_editor_mode_check.value: editor_mode IS NULL OR editor_mode IN (0, 1)
